description: This file implements the login screen for a Flutter application, supporting password-based and OTP-based login methods, as well as password reset functionality.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing the login screen with options for password or OTP login.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: Internal state class managing the login screen logic, including form validation, API interactions, and UI state.

methods.name: _loginWithPassword
methods.description: Handles password-based login by validating input, calling the API, managing failed attempts, and navigation on success.

methods.name: _requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP for login by validating the phone number and calling the API.

methods.name: _verifyOtpAndLogin
methods.description: Verifies OTP input and logs in if successful, storing session tokens.

methods.name: _passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates a password reset process by requesting a reset OTP.

methods.name: _passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirms password reset using OTP and new password, updating session and UI accordingly.
